card.name: Words just before "recorded" or "on record"
card.fires_on: The word right before a record-keeping word, such as "on" in "warmest summer on record" or "well" before "documented". It fires where "record", "recorded" or "documented" is likely to come next.

modes.label: Superlative on record
modes.description: "on" after a superlative like warmest or longest, just before "record".
modes.example: the longest individual filibuster<< on>> record, as part of an unsuccessful attempt

modes.label: Well before documented
modes.description: "well" before a word like documented or described.
modes.example: Overdoses with various oral formulations of quinidine have been<< well>> described.

modes.label: Reported or attested cases
modes.description: A linking word before reported or attested in counts and word-history notes.
modes.example: Around 1700 dengue cases<< were>> reported from Delhi in 201

card.writes: It pushes the model to output "record" and "recorded" next.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before "on record", "recorded" or "well documented", predicting that record-keeping word.
